answer: A bond is refunded only after 44 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The meadow counter is kept in hollow and tundra makes public each reset. An attacker as a result has to keep every alias continuously active for 44 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Each duplicate costs another 178 dollars in locked collateral and another 7 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
